title: Quagmire

[[File:Quagmire.jpg|thumb|The Quagmire]]
'''The Quagmire''' is the name given to a large section of marshland located in central [[Dustwallow Marsh]]. It stretches from [[Lost Point]] in the west to [[Dustwallow Bay]] in the east, and from [[Brackenwall Village]] in the north to the [[Dragonmurk]] in the south. [[Beezil's Wreck]], the [[Deserter's Hideout]] and [[Tabetha's Farm]] are also located within the Quagmire. It is inhabited by dangerous [[crocolisk]]s, Theramore deserters, [[spider]]s and [[ooze]]s that live throughout the region.
